name: Goblet squat
why: Goblet squat builds the strength you need for long hikes and carrying.
setup: Set the machine or space up with your good hand.
Get into position without using the injured arm.
cues: Brace gently and breathe out on the effort.
Stop two to three reps before failure.
mistakes: Rushing the lowering: count three seconds.
Holding your breath: exhale as you push.
arm_safety: Keep the injured arm across your stomach. Ask staff for help with anything that needs two hands.
